## Validation and assumptions

Six screened-in pilot studies formed the development set. The strategy retrieved all six (**100% relative recall on this non-independent development set**); no held-out validation set or matching prior-review benchmark was available, so recall beyond those records is unknown. The search leaves lifestyle and well-being outcomes and population for screening, assuming a study reporting either outcome may qualify. No publication-date, language, or population limits were applied.

The broad exposure search will require substantial screening. The 2020-11-22 bound limits PubMed entry date, but does not reconstruct a historical PubMed/MeSH snapshot; the current COVID-19 MeSH heading was introduced after that date and may have been applied retrospectively.

The [validation manifest](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-7e47969c4c7a654f/lean-fixes-codex-noseed-20261002T135132Z/work/validation-manifest.json) and [search-build notes](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-7e47969c4c7a654f/lean-fixes-codex-noseed-20261002T135132Z/work/narrative.md) are also available.
